The Kinetis KL03: The world's smallest ARM Powered MCU - 1.6 mm x 2.0 mm wafer-level CSP

It's not quite Arduino, but I suspect we will start seeing some new dev boards coming out with this as the core. The miniscule size of this MCU is amazing! I'd love to use it for some ultraminiature projects and wearables. Add this to one of those new cheap WI-FI modules and the IoT gets really interesting. Going to have to keep my eye on this.
